name: LK Advertising — US Realtor 7-step (Hormozi, performance-media, books to cal.com)
target: US real estate agents and small/independent brokerages. LK runs the paid media (Meta/Google) and delivers booked listing appointments, performance based. Books to cal.com/lkadvertising/15min.
voice_notes: Hormozi style: concrete numbers, dream outcome, risk reversal in every step, one ask per email, strong CTA as a question. No hype, no exclamation marks, no fluff. LK's model = LK runs the ads and only gets paid on performance (not a 30/70 commission call-center). Name-optional: use {greeting} not {first_name}. NO em dashes. Renderer adds signature + logo + unsubscribe footer; do not include them.
schedule_doc: delay_days = gap from the previous step. 0,2,2,3,4,7,10 = days 0,2,4,7,11,18,28.

B-side (inline on sequence_steps id 1a8ffedb-742d-4d83-8cc8-a2c34ffc1a51) = give-first teardown opener ('a free teardown for {company}'), which LEADS with the believable keep-it give (reply teardown, a custom 5-min market teardown LK already offers at steps 2-4) instead of the too-good free-ads test. variants.subject: a seller-lead test for {company}
variants.body:
Hi {greeting},

Free offer, no card and no contract. Tell me the main area {company} works and I will run a small batch of listing-appointment ads into it, then hand you every seller lead and booked appointment it produces. You keep all of them.

Here is the shape of a booked appointment the test produces (sample, name changed):

Seller: Karen M.
Property: 3-bed single-family, owner-occupied
Reason for selling: relocating for work, wants to list within 60 days
Appointment: this Thursday at 6pm, at the property
Phone: shared once you confirm

Yours would be real, booked appointments from the area you give me.

I would rather show you it works than tell you. If it produces nothing, you are out nothing but the area name.

Most agents pour budget into a generic home-valuation page and wonder where the sellers went. This puts motivated sellers in front of {company} instead, the listings that actually build a business.

Reply with your area and I will set it up.

variants.subject: still happy to record it
variants.body:
Hi {greeting},

Probably buried by now, so short version.

The offer still stands. I will record a short 5 minute teardown of how your current setup brings in seller leads and where appointments are slipping, made for your market, not a template.

Reply teardown and it is yours, no charge.

{listing_ps}

variants.subject: 6 to 19
variants.body:
Hi {greeting},

One data point in case it helps.

An agent we ran ads for went from 6 listing appointments a month to 19 in about 7 weeks. Same market, same budget, just campaigns built to book appointments instead of collect clicks.

If it is useful, the teardown I offered shows where the same gap is probably costing you appointments right now. Reply teardown and I will record it.

variants.subject: where the leak is
variants.body:
Hi {greeting},

The reason most agent ads underperform is the funnel, not the spend.

Most send sellers to a generic home valuation page and lose them. A seller specific funnel qualifies and books the appointment before it reaches you, so your time only goes to people who showed up to talk listings.

The teardown I offered shows where that leak is in your current setup. Want me to record yours? Reply teardown.

variants.subject: {greeting}, quick one
variants.body:
Hi {greeting},

Different question, takes a few seconds.

If I ran the ads, booked the seller appointments, and you only paid once they were on your calendar, is that worth a look for you?

A yes or a no both work, no wrong answer.

variants.subject: lowest risk version
variants.body:
Hi {greeting},

The lowest risk way to try this.

A 60 day pilot in your market. We build and run the campaigns and deliver booked seller appointments. You pay on performance, so if it does not produce, there is no retainer and you are not locked in.

If you want the pilot scope for your area, grab a 15 minute slot here and I will walk you through it: cal.com/lkadvertising/15min

variants.subject: last one from me
variants.body:
Hi {greeting},

Wrapping up on my end.

If now is not the time, no hard feelings. If you ever want that teardown or want to revisit the pilot, a one word reply is enough and I will pick it back up.

Either way, best of luck with your market this year.
